<objective>
Move the default `attachment-point` on the two male base models from the thigh to the crotch so the
adult-mode dick attachments land where they should.

Purpose: The offset users see is not a renderer bug. The DOM and Canvas renderers already align an
overlay's source point onto the base model's target point to within 0.2px. The base models' default
`attachment-point` coordinates are simply wrong — they sit right of and below the crotch, on the thigh.
Correcting the two coordinate pairs fixes the visible offset at its source.

Output: Two edited metadata JSON files, committed atomically.
</objective>
